relations.description: SMF may include the Ethernet header compression configuration IE under certain conditions.
Inclusion of IE is guarded by network accepting Ethernet PDU session type.
Inclusion of IE is guarded by control plane CIoT 5GS optimization being selected.
Inclusion of IE is guarded by UE providing the IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message may contain Ethernet header compression configuration IE.
UE sends PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.
